test_plan.name: JD-Copilot Frontend Test Plan
test_plan.description: Comprehensive frontend testing for JD-Copilot React interface

tests.name: Application Loading
tests.description: Test that the React application loads correctly

tests.name: Theme Toggle Functionality
tests.expected_behavior: Theme switches between dark and light modes

tests.name: Mascot Character Animation
tests.description: Test mascot character states and animations

tests.name: Particle Vortex Animation
tests.expected_behavior: Particles animate smoothly with vortex effect

tests.name: Message Sending
tests.expected_behavior: Messages are sent and responses received

tests.name: Message Bubble Display
tests.expected_behavior: Messages display correctly with proper styling

tests.name: AI Thinking Feedback
tests.description: Test AI thinking animation during responses
tests.expected_behavior: Thinking animation shows while waiting for AI response

tests.name: Scroll to Bottom
tests.description: Test scroll to bottom button functionality
tests.expected_behavior: Scroll button appears and works correctly

tests.name: Responsive Design
tests.description: Test responsive design on different screen sizes
tests.expected_behavior: Interface adapts to different screen sizes

tests.name: Error Handling
tests.description: Test error handling when backend is unavailable
tests.expected_behavior: Graceful error handling with user feedback

tests.name: Session Management
tests.expected_behavior: Session data persists across page refreshes

tests.name: Accessibility Features
tests.expected_behavior: Interface is accessible to all users
